Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acceptance Tests & Exit Gate Charter

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) and an exit-gate matrix (exit_gate_matrix.md). I put a short list of proposed acceptance tests below so we can iterate quickly: 

- Functional: end-to-end generation for 5 canonical patient scenarios (pass/fail per scenario; sample prompts attached)
- Latency: P95 response time <= 600ms on test traffic (payloads in smoke-test-template)
- Throughput: 50 concurrent sessions with sustained 200 tokens/sec aggregate for 30 minutes
- Fidelity: no more than 4% unacceptable hallucination rate on the canonical prompt set
- Security/compliance: evidence of audit log retention & KMS integration for test tenant

Owners I propose: Ben (test orchestration), Marissa (compliance evidence), Karthik (infra & capacity). Can you confirm these owners or suggest alternates? Also please flag any additional acceptance tests you want included — Lisa, Dan (if you want to loop procurement/proc docs).

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and acceptance tests
- Week 1: environment provisioning & smoke runs
- Week 2: full evaluation and data collection
- Week 3: go/no-go decision + contract handshake

Next steps: please review the attachments and reply with any missing success metrics by EOD Wednesday (2027-08-04).

Thanks,
Hannah

Hannah —

Appreciate the draft and clear owners. A few immediate items from ClinicalOps and Procurement: 

1) Clinical acceptance tests: please add a small set of clinical edge-case prompts around medication reconciliation and allergy inference. We can provide 12 sample cases.
2) Latency: P95 <= 600ms sounds good but can we also include a 99th percentile upper bound for peak traffic? Suggest P99 <= 1.2s.
3) Compliance evidence: procurement needs SOC2 in-scope confirmation and a data retention statement for the test tenant. Dan — would you like a short vendor questionnaire before committing to the timeline?

We can confirm owners: ClinicalOps will own the clinical scenarios (Lisa), Procurement will own contract and vendor evidence (Dan).

Two asks for Redwood: please include a short runbook for smoke-test reproducibility (who runs what, commands, sample payloads). If you can attach a template for the smoke run that would help — Dan is working on aligning procurement windows.

I’ll review the MAP sheet with my team and send suggested edits by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Lisa Gray

Thanks — quick iteration from engineering/test perspective. I created a smoke-test template (smoke-test-template.yaml) with the commands and payload shapes; attaching here. Key additions and suggested thresholds: 

- Add a reproducibility section: seed inputs, random-seed=42 for sampling checks, deterministic decoding where appropriate
- Fault injection: run 10-minute degraded-network test (10% packet loss emulation) to validate graceful degradation and fallback model variants
- Concordance test: for 200 clinician-labeled prompts, require >= 92% agreement (binary pass/fail per prompt)
- Roll-forward criterion: if concordance is within 2% of baseline but latency regressions exist, require a mitigation plan and a new test run within 72 hours

Suggested timeline (concrete):
- Aug 2–4: infra & test harness setup (Karthik leads infra)
- Aug 5–11: smoke + full test suite (Ben leads testing)
- Aug 12–14: results consolidation, executive review (Hannah & Lisa)

I’ll coordinate the orchestration and share a Jenkins job + artifact links.

Ben Carter

A couple of governance items we should include in the exit-gate charter: 

- Rollback triggers: explicit metrics that trigger immediate rollback to the prior model (e.g., fidelity failures > 6% OR sustained P95 > 1.0s for 30+ minutes)
- Data retention: confirm that any logs/samples collected for the eval will be purged after 90 days unless otherwise agreed
- Evidence owners: pick a single owner for each artifact (e.g., SOC2 evidence — Marissa; audit logs — Karthik)

Also, can infra confirm that HealthLogic's test tenant will be VPC-isolated and that KMS keys will be provisioned prior to smoke runs? Karthik — can you confirm availability for Aug 2–4?
